audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-4 disagree with both the packet chart and their own whys: Levels 1-2 are marked Warwick/Skill though the whys say Nautilus wins them, and Levels 4-5 and 6 are marked Skill though the whys say his sustain and suppress win outright.
audit.why: Pre-Blood-Hunt Warwick has only Eternal Hunger's weak heal, so the passive-root trade is free; from 4 his Q heal and Infinite Duress (110s at rank 1) reverse every extended fight.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 Nautilus, Level 3 Skill, Levels 4-5 and 6 Warwick.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 2-3, level 6 Infinite Duress, his first bruiser item, and full build — matching where the drain race flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Dredge Line's hard CC stops Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress mid-leap, and Blood Hunt's 50%/25% health thresholds are never mentioned.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a leap, so CC landing on Warwick in flight denies the suppress entirely; Eternal Hunger's healing triples under 25% health, which is why anti-heal must be up before the trade, not after.
audit.corrected: State the CC-denies-his-leap rule and the Blood Hunt thresholds.

edits.before: Anti-heal — Q-hook into CC, W-shield his on-hit. Nautilus wins the Infinite Duress cooldown windows.
edits.after: Anti-heal early — Dredge Line stops his Q lunge and Infinite Duress mid-leap. Trade short.

edits.before: Anti-heal and chain CC him. Track Infinite Duress before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Anti-heal and hold Dredge Line for his leap — CC in flight kills Infinite Duress. Trade short, never long.

edits.before: His all-in suppress. Q-peel around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 110s suppress at rank 1 — fight in that window, or hook him out of the leap.

edits.before: That is Warwick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Blood Hunt scents you under 50% and triples under 25% — recall before you get there.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Eternal Hunger triples its healing under 25% — bring Grievous Wounds first.

notes: Chart rows 0-4 flipped as one paired group to match the packet chart and the existing whys. Added the Dredge-Line-denies-his-leap interaction and Blood Hunt's health thresholds from the missing-interactions file.
